title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Member Terms — Recent Vacation Supplies
content:
**Term.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, recent vacation supplies reduce the vacation supply:

- when a vacation supply for the drug was granted in the last six months, 15 days are taken off;
- when the most recent one was granted six to twelve months ago, 5 days are taken off;
- otherwise nothing is taken off.

The vacation supplies looked at are the vacation-supply overrides already granted on the benefit for the same drug.

## Reading the term

| Most recent earlier vacation supply for the drug | Days taken off |
|---|---|
| Granted within the last six months | 15 |
| Granted six to twelve months ago | 5 |
| Granted more than twelve months ago, or none | 0 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical members)

- A member had a vacation supply of Jardiance two months ago: 15 days are taken off.
- A member's last vacation supply of Jardiance was nine months ago: 5 days are taken off.
- A member's only earlier vacation supply was for a different drug: nothing is taken off for this drug.
